title: runtime/plan
description: PlanProposal contract (feature 005; FR-402): the typed output a planning-tier model (rimbrain.plan) must emit. Actions dispatch through the feature-004 single writer; policy_mutations materialize candidate pack revisions. Malformed output is a named error, never a guess.

plan_id.description: id grammar (common/id) with the plan. prefix.

base_revision.description: sha256 canonical hash of the pack the plan was built against.

actions.description: Dispatcher actions the plan wants executed; validated against template params_schema at review AND at dispatch.

op.description: Candidate-pack edit kind; nothing else is legal.

target.description: Id the mutation applies to (new template id, decision_map question, or emergency rule id).

patch.description: Replacement/insert fragment applied into the candidate pack.

rationale.description: Model's stated reasoning; recorded, never executed.
